summary: TalentGenius, an OpenAI SMB Channel Partner, distributes ChatGPT Business signup links via a request form. An X post by @Rakib_Web3 (2026-08-22) claims that paying $25/mo for one seat gets a second seat completely free for 4 years through this partner program. The claim terms are not stated on TalentGenius's public pages and remain unverified.
claim_steps: Fill out the form at https://talentgenius.io/chatgpt/request (name, work email, company, region, team size).
Receive your unique ChatGPT Business signup link from TalentGenius.
Subscribe to ChatGPT Business ($25/mo per seat) using the link.
Add the second seat to the workspace at no extra cost, per the claimed partner promotion.
